title: PowerCo — SME churn model
metrics_note: High accuracy is an artifact of the 9.7% base rate. Recall 0.06 and AUC ~0.53 mean the model barely beats random at actually catching churners.
top_drivers: Months since last product update / renewal
signals: Clients with <=4 months tenure churn markedly more (~4pp jump between months 4 and 5).
Customers who also buy gas churn ~2% less (multi-product loyalty).
Price sensitivity (Dec-Jan off-peak price change) is a WEAK churn signal.
takeaway: Price alone does not explain churn. A blanket 20% discount is poorly targeted; prioritise early-life onboarding, margin-aware retention and gas cross-sell, and fix the model (rebalance, tune threshold, optimise recall) before trusting it.
